Python — Internal participation in deformation LUT

Correspond intrinsics.py, Write/Restore interface by calibration.py Export.

API Reference

get_camera_matrix(ip)

Purpose: Read deep camera needle perforate.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

Returns: 9 Bank Priority list[float] or None.

get_distortion(ip)

Purpose: Read Brown-Conrady Aberration.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

Returns: [k1,k2,p1,p2,k3] or None; Zero is an effective result.

get_camera_parameters(ip)

Purpose: Reads the complete internal and external input that the camera currently saves.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

Returns: dict[str, Any] or None; field pools are determined by the camera reconstructioner and the image source.

get_undistort_lut(…​)

Purpose: Online Access & Cache LUT.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

depth_width

int

Value of depth_width.

depth_height

int

Value of depth_height.

camera_matrix

Sequence[float]

Row-major 3×3 camera intrinsic matrix; Default: None.

distortion

Sequence[float]

Brown-Conrady distortion coefficients; Default: None.

Returns: float32 ndarray(H,W,2) or None.

compute_undistort_lut(…​)

Purpose: Local pure calculation LUT.

Parameters

Name Type Description

width

int

Image width in pixels.

height

int

Image height in pixels.

camera_matrix

Sequence[float]

Row-major 3×3 camera intrinsic matrix.

distortion

Sequence[float]

Brown-Conrady distortion coefficients.

Returns: float32 ndarray(H,W,2);modified to full zero or invalid as None.

clear_undistort_lut_cache(ip=None)

Purpose: Clear specified camera or all LUT Cache.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

Optional[str]

Camera address; Default: None.

Returns: None.

set_intrinsic_parameters(ip, camera_parameters_config)

Purpose: Writes and applies the full internal and external participatory configuration.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

camera_parameters_config

CameraParametersConfig

Complete intrinsic and extrinsic configuration.

Returns: bool; True Shows success in writing.

restore_factory_intrinsic(ip)

Purpose: Restor the camera out of the plant.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

Returns: bool; True This is a sign of recovery success. == Example: Online access LUT

matrix = epiceye.get_camera_matrix(ip)
distortion = epiceye.get_distortion(ip)
if matrix is None or distortion is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to read instr. %1")

lut = epiceye.get_undistort_lut(
    ip,
    depth_width=2048,
    depth_height=1536,
    camera_matrix=matrix,
    distortion=distortion,
)

Example: Read the full camera internal and external reference

parameters = epiceye.get_camera_parameters(ip)
if parameters is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to read full camera internal and external connection")

print(json.dumps(parameters, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
